name: PRISME platforms
full_name: Magnetic catheter navigation platforms of the Belharet lab (8-coil EMA with haptic and VR teleoperation; KUKA-held permanent magnet with motorized catheter driver)
group: Belharet, PRISME EA 4229, Junia HEI / Univ. Orleans
versions: VHMM: 8-electromagnet EMA of the lab + PI XYZ positioner pushing the catheter + Omega.6 haptic master + Simscape VR (elfakir2022_towards, AIM 2022); KUKA LBR iiwa R14 holding a 70 x 70 mm NdFeB magnet + motorized catheter driver + glass phantom (elfakir2022_magnetic, ICARM 2022); PhD thesis 2024 (HAL tel-04914777, not opened)
target_anatomy: complex vascular networks and small arteries (2 mm), applications named: brain tumours, stenosis, cardiac ablation, renal artery occlusion (elfakir2022_magnetic Sec. I, Fig. 1)
devices_driven: own magnetic catheters: LDPE shaft with 3 NdFeB magnets (1 mm x 3 mm) at the tip (elfakir2022_towards Sec. II-B); 1 mm catheter with 3 magnets (1 x 3 mm, 8 mm spacing) in LDPE tube (elfakir2022_magnetic Table I, Fig. 6B)
n_dof_detail: EMA version: 2 bending angles + 1 insertion from the haptic device (elfakir2022_towards Sec. V); arm version: 7-DoF arm + motorized insertion (elfakir2022_magnetic Sec. IV-C)
translation_detail: magnetic (tip steering); linear-stage push of the proximal end (PI XYZ stage, elfakir2022_towards Sec. II-A; motorized catheter control system, elfakir2022_magnetic Sec. IV-C)
rotation_detail: field of 8 fixed electromagnets (EMA) or pose of a permanent magnet on a 7-DoF arm (KUKA)
force_sensing: none on the catheter; haptic forces come from virtual contact in the VR model (Ks = 1000 N/m, bm = 30 Ns/m, elfakir2022_towards Sec. III-D)
haptics_leader: Omega.6 (Force Dimension) with force feedback from simulated contacts (elfakir2022_towards Sec. II-A, III-D)
imaging_compat: cameras only (stereo vision; CCD camera tracking)
validation_detail: glass phantom with 2 mm arteries, 20 cm path and four successive bifurcations (45 and 90 deg): three navigations, all reached the target (elfakir2022_magnetic Sec. IV-C, Fig. 8); free-space and glass-vessel deflection under the EMA (elfakir2022_towards Figs. 6-8)
key_numbers: max tip deflection 155 deg (elfakir2022_magnetic Sec. IV-B); first navigation 35 s including actuator moves (Sec. IV-C); EMA current-to-angle polynomial model of degree 2 with error 0.39 (elfakir2022_towards Sec. IV-A); magnet 70 x 70 mm, Br 1.42 T (elfakir2022_magnetic Sec. II)
sim_model: Simscape (MATLAB) multibody model of the catheter with a spatial contact-force model, run alongside the real catheter as VR (elfakir2022_towards Sec. III); Euler-Bernoulli multi-element deflection model for catheter design (elfakir2022_magnetic Sec. II)
sim2real_detail: none found (the virtual model drives haptic feedback while the real catheter runs open loop; no simulation-trained controller, elfakir2022_towards Sec. IV)
